schemaNotes.aggregateCanonicalTalentNames: Union of verified talent publications when sufficiently audited; null/unfinalized until expansion coverage is complete.
schemaNotes.referenceClassAccess: Aggregate class-usage reference from the secondary index; never treated as source-local provenance by itself.
schemaNotes.accessPublications: Primary-source-verified class access grants, recorded by publication.
schemaNotes.aggregateClassAccess: Current aggregate reference/access target; later normalized from verified access publications as coverage becomes complete.
